description: Read any job. Includes status, step (queued, transcribe, translate, burn, finalize, done, failed), progress (0-100, burn uses real ffmpeg progress), eta_seconds and estimatedCompletionAt (from media length x rolling per-step averages), pollAfterSeconds (wait that long before the next poll), cost, and an expiring result URL when the job succeeded. A batch id returns the batch view (counts and item jobs). A failed caption job with resumable:true can be restarted with resume_job.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

jobId.description: Job id returned by transcribe or burn_captions.

name: get_job

outputSchema.description: A job: poll get_job with id until status is succeeded or failed.

error.description: Failure reason when status is failed.

expiresAt.description: When the result files are deleted.

id.description: Job id: pass it to get_job, resume_job, edit_transcript or as transcriptionJobId.

kind.description: Job kind (transcribe, burn, caption, clips, shorts, trim, dub, translate, preview, metadata...).

result.description: Result when succeeded: url, files[{name, url}], clips, text...
